title: Apple is holding a global iPhone photography contest, and the prize is that your photo could be used on a billboard (AAPL)
text: Apple is holding a global iPhone photography contest, and the prize is that your photo could be used on a billboard (AAPL) By Kif Leswing Jan 22, 2019, 2:31 pm 16 pts Apple is running a contest to identify 10 of the best photos taken on an iPhone. The photos will be judged by a panel of 10 people including Barack Obama's former personal photographer. Winners of the contest will see their photo used in Apple marketing.
